snippet.title: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic | Official Game Trailer! 🦄🕹️
snippet.description:
The Academy is opening its doors for new students in this brand new game! Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic arrives on November 17th, wherever you play games!


Welcome to Unicorn Academy! 🦄✨

Join Sophia, Wildstar and their friends for magical adventures at Unicorn Academy, where powerful unicorns, loyal friendships and exciting mysteries await around every corner.
If you love unicorns, magical creatures, friendship stories and fun adventures, you're in the right place! Watch full episodes, original shorts, music videos, magical moments and more from Unicorn Academy.
 
🌈 Watch More Unicorn Academy

🦄 Full Episodes: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pMhqjqdmEDA&list=PL6icaH5xf_lC1E9xYxgNlrLZGMEEVIkiD

✨ Friendship Takes Flight: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LKXfQJpzXoA&list=PLU9do0tfx7oQ

🌟 Unicorn Academy Original Shorts: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4uSSrfEmJA&list=PL6icaH5xf_lDnbShNXpyDjMaoWLdNcXd1

🎵 Music Videos & Songs: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nyo3IsHJFEc&list=PL6icaH5xf_lCpva1tUIKhoS9Ca0sHq483
 
💜 Subscribe for More Magic
Official Unicorn Academy Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@UnicornAcademyOfficial/featured
 
🦄 About Unicorn Academy
At Unicorn Academy, every rider forms a special bond with their unicorn. Together they'll discover magical powers, face exciting challenges and learn that friendship is the greatest magic of all.
